title: Unlock 1,200+ hidden Mac settings for a one-time $29.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: MacPilot unlocks more than 1,200 macOS features through a point-and-click interface instead of the command line. Get a lifetime license for $29.97 (reg. $99).

Want to change your screenshot format, add spacers to the Dock, or show hidden files without typing a single Terminal command?

Get a MacPilot lifetime license for $29.97 (reg. $99.00) and keep it for good.

MacPilot puts more than 1,200 macOS features behind the familiar Mac interface, so tweaks that normally live in the command line are a click away. Display hidden files in Finder, disable the startup chime, toggle animations, and show the file path in the window title bar.

Tweak it, tune it, troubleshoot it

The Dock gets spacers and smart stacks, and maintenance scripts like cron and launch services run whenever your system needs a tune-up.

MacPilot also builds a detailed system profile, from your graphics card and RAM bus speeds to your serial number. Reference lists cover network ports, error codes, and key combos.

The license works on up to three Macs running macOS 10.15 or later and includes all minor and major upgrades at no extra cost.

MacPilot holds an average of 4.6 out of 5 stars from 46 verified buyers, along with a 4.0 out of 5 rating on MacUpdate. For Mac users who’ve outgrown System Settings but don’t want to live in Terminal, it’s a practical middle ground.

Get lifetime access to MacPilot for $29.97 (reg. $99.00) while it’s still marked down.
